purpose: Turn discovered benchmark and capability gaps into a bounded, evidence-driven remediation queue.
ranking_rule: Rank by safety/user impact first, then shared-fix leverage and recurrence, then measurable quality/performance impact, while penalizing high uncertainty and high verification cost.
deduplication_rule: Group failures by normalized root cause, affected capability, route, tool, fixture, and runtime binding before proposing repairs.
anti_gaming: do not change fixtures only to improve scores
do not convert missing evidence to pass
do not count external-model assistance as native mastery
next_action: Select the highest-priority unresolved gap with a safe, testable, bounded repair hypothesis; otherwise report blocked/needs-owner rather than fabricate progress.
